title: Crane on a slope? Here's how we level it
lines: A street going up or down? That changes everything.
Before lifting, we open the outriggers and level the truck.
Under the outriggers go load spreaders, especially on soft ground.
If the slope is too steep, we don't lift. We find another spot.
Stability isn't a small detail. It's the base of the whole job.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Safety first.
